Protocol Symposium 2026 — Recording

The Political Economy of Protocols

trent van epps

Wednesday, September 23, 2026 · 21:30 UTC

Watch on YouTube →

About this talk

Protocols generate value far beyond what they capture. That generativity requires ongoing governance, labor, funding, and legitimacy. Whoever governs those flows thereby shapes the protocol.

This talk builds a four-corner framework from Lessig's "pathetic dot" theory (norms, new nature, market, and state), and proposes measurable indicators for each corner to make the framework. The meandering and vectors of each political economy over time can then be mapped into a diagram series. Case studies include: the English commons, the CHI conference, Chromium, DNS/ICANN, Linux, and Ethereum.
